t: You're standing in Old Palace Yard, a paved open space between the Palace of Westminster and Westminster Abbey. It's known as a place of executions, including those of Sir Walter Raleigh, Guy Fawkes and the other Gunpowder Plot conspirators. In 1649 two men died here: James Hamilton, the 1st Duke of Hamilton, a Scottish nobleman and leader in the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, and Arthur Capell, Baron Capell, a Royalist whom parliament ordered executed.
